commercial_position: LumenCore sells one controlled technical decision, not a promise of performance.

offer.name: LumenCore 30-Day Bounded Validation Sprint
pre_registered_fields: execution boundary and human approval owner
economic denominator, eligibility, realization, cost, and non-overlap group
required_deliverables: signed evaluation contract or authorized purchase instrument
claim_boundary: No guaranteed outcome, savings, ROI, certification, deployment, agency endorsement, award, or production authorization.
Internal or buyer-authorized replay is not field validation unless the qualified data owner approves the protocol and the resulting claim in writing.
Visualizations and dashboards project verifier state; they cannot strengthen the evidence result.
No dollar value conversion is allowed until the technical gate passes and buyer-owned denominator, eligibility, realization, cost, and non-overlap inputs are complete.
System, market, asset, transaction, or spend scale is not a savings denominator by itself.

required_inputs: denominator currency, unit, and time window

tiers.name: Launch Replay
tiers.best_for: A startup, lab, or operator needing one credible baseline-versus-candidate decision.

tiers.name: Standard Sprint
tiers.best_for: A buyer or technical reviewer who needs repeatability, one controlled rerun, and an executive decision packet.

tiers.name: Institutional Sprint
tiers.best_for: An enterprise, utility, prime contractor, or regulated team needing a buyer-owned holdout, integration workshop, and procurement-ready handoff.

payment.commercial_default: 50 percent at signed scope; 50 percent at delivery of the agreed evidence packet.
payment.government_boundary: Government payment, invoicing, and acceptance follow the controlling procurement instrument rather than this commercial default.
payment.out_of_scope_work: Requires written change order before execution.

ip_boundary.background_ip: Each party retains its pre-existing intellectual property, data, code, models, methods, names, and documentation.
ip_boundary.buyer_data: Buyer-authorized data remains controlled by the buyer or its named rights owner.
ip_boundary.sprint_outputs: Ownership and license rights for buyer-specific outputs must be stated in the signed scope. No transfer is implied by this proposed offer.
ip_boundary.publicity: No customer, partner, validation, result, or logo may be named publicly without written permission.
